title: WF03 ADP-06 blocker set: ES-06 up_to_sequence query regression and missing audit pipeline_run_id persistence
summary: Resolved both WF02 ADP-06 blockers: fixed ES-06 read(up_to_sequence) SQL regression in event_store, and restored deterministic pipeline_run_id propagation to both event metadata and audit rows by carrying trusted pipeline_run_id through append and applying it to the DB session for trigger/audit paths.

root_cause.details: The ES-06 read(up_to_sequence) branch used an invalid query shape/parameter mapping causing server-side query failure. Separately, ADP-06 audit correlation depended on implicit context propagation and did not reliably persist pipeline_run_id to audit rows in the integration execution path.

changes: Rewrote Store.read up_to_sequence SQL branch to filter by instance_id and sequence_number <= K with ordered results, removing the broken placeholder usage.
Extended AppendParams with optional trusted pipeline_run_id and used it as primary source for metadata correlation.
Applied set_config('bpm.pipeline_run_id', ...) on the append transaction connection so audit persistence paths observe the same run-id context deterministically.
Hardened ADP-06 integration test setup for deterministic idempotency-key pre-clean and explicit trusted pipeline_run_id propagation input.

prevention: For sequence-bounded reads, keep SQL placeholders and predicate semantics aligned with the API contract and cover with dedicated integration assertions.
For cross-cutting correlation fields used by triggers/audit, set required DB session context explicitly on the same transaction connection used for writes.
In ADP correlation tests, pre-clean deterministic idempotency keys to avoid hidden duplicate-path noise.
